plan.title: Explore dataset structure and annotations
plan.description: Write scratch.py to examine: (1) number of images in data/train/images/, (2) structure of annotations.json (categories, images, annotations counts), (3) annotation distribution per image (min/max/mean), (4) category distribution (how many annotations per category), (5) image dimensions, (6) structure of metadata.json, (7) reference product images in data/products/. Log all findings.
plan.success_criteria: Complete understanding of data properties: 248 images, ~22700 annotations, 357 categories, image sizes, reference image availability per category

plan.title: Check environment and install dependencies
plan.description: Check installed versions of ultralytics, torch, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes. Verify GPU availability and VRAM. Install any missing packages.
plan.success_criteria: All required packages available, GPU confirmed

plan.title: Create train/val split and evaluation function
plan.description: Write scripts to: (1) Split annotations.json into train_split.json and val_split.json (90/10, seed=42, stratified by image filename patterns for store sections). (2) Implement val_score = 0.7 * detection_mAP@0.5 + 0.3 * classification_mAP@0.5 evaluation using pycocotools COCOeval. (3) Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format for both splits. Create dataset YAML config.
plan.success_criteria: Train/val splits created, evaluation function tested, YOLO format labels generated

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8m nc=1 at 640
plan.hypothesis: A single-class YOLOv8m detector at 640px establishes a solid detection baseline, achieving detection_mAP@0.5 > 0.3
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m with nc=1 (all categories mapped to class 0), imgsz=640, epochs=100, batch=16. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 on val split. This skips smaller models since we need strong detection for the two-stage pipeline.

plan.title: YOLOv8m nc=1 at 1280
plan.hypothesis: Higher resolution significantly improves detection on dense shelves with small products, gaining 5+ mAP points
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=150, batch=8. Compare detection_mAP to 640px baseline.

plan.title: YOLOv8l nc=1 at 1280
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8l provides better detection than YOLOv8m at 1280, worth the extra compute
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=200, batch=4. Compare to YOLOv8m at 1280.

plan.title: Explore reference images and build DINOv2 classification pipeline
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-base kNN classification on ground-truth val crops achieves top-1 accuracy > 30%
plan.description: Analyze data/products/ reference images. Implement DINOv2-base (dinov2_vitb14 from timm) embedding pipeline: extract embeddings from crops, build gallery from training crops + reference images, classify via cosine similarity kNN. Test on ground-truth val crops to measure classification upper bound.
plan.success_criteria: Classification pipeline working, top-1 accuracy > 30% on GT crops

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: best detector + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: nc=1 detector + DINOv2 classification achieves val_score > 0.25
plan.description: Run best nc=1 detector on val images, crop detections, classify with DINOv2 kNN. Compute full val_score (0.7*det_mAP + 0.3*cls_mAP). This is the first end-to-end evaluation.

plan.title: Tune kNN and gallery composition
plan.hypothesis: Optimal k, distance metric, and gallery composition improve classification mAP by 0.03+
plan.description: Sweep k in {1,3,5,7}, test cosine vs L2, and compare gallery variants (reference only, training crops only, combined with different weightings). Use GT val crops for fast iteration.

plan.title: NMS and confidence threshold tuning
plan.hypothesis: Tuning NMS IoU and confidence thresholds improves detection mAP by 1-3 points
plan.description: Sweep NMS IoU threshold {0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7} and confidence threshold {0.001,0.01,0.05,0.1,0.25} on val split with best detector.

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference at 1280 with overlap improves detection of small products by 3+ mAP points
plan.description: Implement tiled inference: slice images into overlapping 1280x1280 tiles (stride 960), run detector on each tile + full image, merge with NMS/WBF. Compare detection_mAP to single-pass.

plan.title: TTA and multi-scale ensemble
plan.hypothesis: TTA and/or multi-scale inference provides 1-2 mAP point improvement
plan.description: Test TTA (augment=True) and multi-scale inference (640+1280) with WBF merging. Compare to single-pass best detector.

plan.title: DINOv2-large for classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large produces better embeddings, improving classification accuracy by 3+ points
plan.description: Load DINOv2-large (dinov2_vitl14), build gallery, evaluate on val crops. Compare to DINOv2-base. Check model size fits within 420MB budget.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy improves by 3+ points over DINOv2-base

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=357 at 1280 comparison
plan.hypothesis: End-to-end nc=357 YOLO may be competitive with two-stage for classification
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x nc=357, imgsz=1280, epochs=300, close_mosaic=50. Compare both detection_mAP and classification_mAP to two-stage pipeline. Determine if hybrid approach (YOLO class when confident, DINOv2 otherwise) is beneficial.
plan.success_criteria: Understand relative strengths of end-to-end vs two-stage

plan.title: Post-processing: spatial consistency and co-occurrence
plan.hypothesis: Shelf-aware post-processing improves classification by 1-2 mAP points
plan.description: Implement: (1) Adjacent detection consistency - group by shelf row, majority vote for similar embeddings. (2) Co-occurrence priors from training data. Evaluate improvement on val split.

plan.title: Build complete inference pipeline
plan.description: Assemble best configuration into run.py: load models, detect, crop, classify, format output. Handle edge cases. Test on val split end-to-end. Ensure no blocked imports.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline runs end-to-end on val split producing correct output format

plan.title: Inference timing and model size optimization
plan.hypothesis: Pipeline fits within 300s time limit and 420MB size limit
plan.description: Time complete pipeline on val split, extrapolate to test set. Audit model sizes. Apply FP16/ONNX export if needed. Optimize bottlenecks (batch DINOv2 inference, etc.).
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline within time and size limits

plan.title: Final val_score evaluation
plan.description: Run complete optimized pipeline on val split. Log final val_score breakdown: detection_mAP, classification_mAP, combined score. Make any final adjustments.

plan.title: Package final submission
plan.description: Create submission with run.py, model weights (≤3 files, ≤420MB), gallery file, helper files. Verify sandbox compatibility (no os/sys/subprocess, use pathlib). Test extraction and run.
